means: The rendering of out-of-focus points of light - the soft glowing discs a background of lamps or highlights melts into behind a shallow lens.
does: Turns background highlights into soft glowing discs. It is well-trained danbooru vocabulary and lands reliably, with two caveats. It needs something to work on: bokeh is a CONSEQUENCE of shallow focus, so pair it with depth of field / blurry background or the model may have nothing to blur - the bokeh_shape card was written without a focus anchor in its fixed subject and its own review flags exactly that. And the SHAPE does not exist: aperture-blade vocabulary is not in danbooru, the model has one bokeh concept, and the measurement bears it out - hexagonal against oval_anamorphic came back the closest pair on that card at 16.42, inside recomposition noise. Ask for bokeh; do not ask for hexagonal bokeh.
reach_for_it: for night exteriors, streets and stadiums, where the background is nothing but points of light - it is most of a night film's identity
used_in: studio/cards/shot_lens_bokeh_shape.json (six shapes, three separable at most); the shallow options of shot_focus_dof.json and shot_focus.json
